div.div:
Notes
*1 Failed at container creation
failed to fulfil mount request: ... no such file or directory, then CrashLoopBackOff after 5 restarts in about 6 minutes. The cause was not isolated.
*2 Scope of the observation
2026-11-10, ap-northeast-1, one observation. Trident EKS add-on v26.6.2-eksbuild.1. iSCSI and NVMe/TCP block volumes were not tried.
*3 What the documentation lists
Storage with Nitro Sandboxes lists Amazon EBS, Amazon EFS, tmpfs-backed CSI drivers, and others. It does not mention NFS from third-party CSI drivers.
